messages:
marco: Quick sync: proposing a temporary model pin for `gptx-instruct-long` during the kernel rollforward tonight. Window 23:00-02:00 UTC. Need ops + infra ack.
anya: why a model pin vs runtime pin? are we seeing behavioral diffs?
marco: Observed subtle tokenization drift on quantized checkpoints after kernel change in staging. Pin keeps production traffic on previous model weights while we validate the rollforward.
deploybot: Command: `deploybot pin temp model gptx-instruct-long v1.4.2 --reason "kernel-rollforward-validation" --until 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z` -> cohorts: global-canary, eu-west-1.
gloria: If pinned, routing will serve a stable v1.4.1 for the cohort, right? Any special shim?
infra-raf: Correct: routing maps gptx-instruct-long -> model v1.4.1 for pinned cohorts. No shim. We've validated shard compatibility.
qa-kyu: QA plan: replay focused prompts with long instruction sequences + structured output checks. I'll run the suite at 22:30 UTC and upload to /tmp/pin-check.json.
anya: rollback criteria? thresholds?
marco: Abort if: (1) >0.5% increase in decode mismatches vs baseline over 10m; (2) >3x spike in user-visible errors; (3) any semantic regression flagged by automated evals on critical prompt sets.
deploybot: Note: teams can opt-out with `deploybot pin-sticky model gptx-instruct-long v1.4.1` before 21:30 UTC. Sticky pins persist past the auto-unpin.
infra-raf: Ops note: Dedicated customers running long-instruction flows in us-west could see changed routing if not pinned; I'll send CS advisory.
gloria: docs: will add short blurb to release notes explaining the temporary model pin and customer impact.
qa-kyu: Replay summary: 12k prompts, 0.42% decode diffs (within threshold), structured-output stable. Posting report: /tmp/pin-check.json
marco: Thanks QA. Proceeding to schedule pin at 23:00 UTC. If anyone objects, file sticky-pin by 21:30.
deploybot: Execution: pin job started -> id mj-5801234567. Live logs: https://internal-logs/deploy/mj-5801234567
anya: Observability check: no latency regression, error rate stable.
infra-raf: CS advisory sent. Escalation list included.
gloria: Added release note at /internal/docs/releases/5801234567-model-pin.md
marco: Locking thread. Will reopen if rollback needed. Thanks all.
